x-e-h1-10.s.s1.explain: If clear refusal (can't), reason, and alternative (another day) all dey together, other person no go misunderstand and e go hurt less. Vague answer make person wait; too-blunt answer strain relationship.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.prompt:
Make English conversation between A and B. Start every line A: or B:, and write at least 4 lines.
Condition 1) B clearly say B no fit go (can't, etc.).
Condition 2) B give reason.
Condition 3) B suggest another day or way.
Condition 4) A show understanding.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: First choose reason (family event etc.) and alternative (another day), then plan line order.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: For B first reply, put 'thanks' first, then use can't.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: B refusal clear, or vague like 'I go try come'?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Alternative na suggestion wey dem fit do (get date or way)?
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.1: Same conditions met even with different situation.
x-e-h1-10.s.s2.modelNote.2: Same conditions met with different expressions.
